{{Infobox auto}}
'''Charred fish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking any fish in a [[Mud Kiln]]. It heals {{Value|Charred Fish|heals}}, less than a properly cooked fish.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Any fish in the vanilla fish group (cod, salmon, pufferfish and tropical fish, including all custom [[fish]], and also [[cooked fish]] and [[cooked large fish]]) turns into charred fish in a mud kiln in {{Value|Charred Fish|cook_time}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_fish.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration IV for 15 ticks, which heals {{Value|Charred Fish|heals}}.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|The recipe takes the whole fish group instead of four listed fish, so cooked fish and cooked large fish can be charred too. Firing takes 10 seconds instead of 5.}}
}}
